x: The Mile Relay, the first fixture of the newly-constituted Southern Amateur Athletic League, was won by the Polytechnic II , with S.L H. second and ourselves third. We were drawn on the outside of the track, but Titherley, running the first stage, handed over second, Jack Jones ran the second stage, A.
In the two Sprint Relays we were badly let down by the non-appearance of two of our sprinters, and Jack Jones and Jim Tosh, two half-milers, had to be called upon to fill the gaps.

This order was maintained over the next stage and Jack Jones started off third with Booth, the Poly champion, a few yards behind him. Booth passed Jack in the concluding stages, and so we finished fourth.
